React Router: Potential CSRF via PUT/PATCH/DELETE document requests

@acastellon/auth: Authentication bypass via spoofable headers in validateToken()

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

@acastellon/auth v2.2.0 appears to allow an unauthenticated authentication bypass in validateToken() through spoofable auth-user and Host request headers. The validateToken middleware contains a service-to-service bypass for auth-user: service-brother when req.get('host').startsWith(getHostName()). As a result, a remote unauthenticated attacker can send a request with crafted headers and bypass token validation before the normal legacy/JWT/OIDC validation logic runs. entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-hfxv-24rg-xrqf: Axios: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via Cookie Name Injection
entry.content:
Axios: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via Cookie Name Injection

Aliases: CVE-2026-44496

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • axios — fixed in 1.16.0
  • axios — fixed in 0.32.0

## Summary Axios versions before `0.32.0` on the `0.x` line and before `1.16.0` on the `1.x` line build a regular expression from the configured XSRF cookie name without escaping regex metacharacters.
